cases.prompt:
Add something to our AGENTS.md so agents know about docs/testing.md, which explains how to run the integration tests against the local Postgres container. Current AGENTS.md:

# Agents
Start at SKILLS.md: it maps each task to the playbook that owns it.
assertions: The reply puts the pointer to docs/testing.md in the SKILLS.md router rather than as a new line in AGENTS.md, or explains that AGENTS.md should keep its one pointer to the router.
The pointer's wording states when to read docs/testing.md, such as when running, writing or debugging integration tests.
The reply does not copy the content of docs/testing.md (Postgres container commands or setup steps) into AGENTS.md or SKILLS.md.

cases.prompt:
Tighten this rule from one of our skills:

Don't write long comments. Never explain what the code does line by line. Don't add comments that just restate the code. Comments should be good.
assertions: The rewrite states the wanted behaviour positively, for example "write one-line comments that say why".
The rewrite contains at most one prohibition ("don't", "never" or "do not").
The rewrite removes "Comments should be good" or replaces it with a concrete rule, or the reply calls it a no-op.
The two rules about explaining or restating what the code does become one rule.
